rewind.screen.title: Rewind
rewind.screen.hint: Drag the timeline to pick a moment.
rewind.screen.elsewhere: You were in %s here · rewinding takes you there
rewind.settings.title: Rewind Settings
rewind.settings.key.tooltip: Click, then press a key. Esc keeps the current one.
rewind.settings.history.tooltip: How much memory the recorded history may use. When it is full, the oldest part is dropped. Auto uses a quarter of Minecraft's memory, at most 768 MB.
rewind.settings.jump.tooltip: How far before the moment the timeline opens when you click a marker or rewind from the death screen.
rewind.settings.death_button.tooltip: Show a Rewind button on the death screen.
rewind.screen.keys: ← → step  ·  Shift 5 s  ·  Enter rewind here  ·  Esc cancel
